title: Route all shape-creation paths through planar merge (agent, copy/paste, JSFL) via a shared commit helper + verify draw-on-tween
description: The P5 merge-by-default cutover only wired merge into the UI draw path (Shell.tsx handleShapeCreated -> planarMergeCommit). Other shape-creation entry points still call addDisplayObject directly and do NOT merge, so programmatic/paste drawing diverges from interactive drawing (no same-color union / different-color cut / line-split). Found by integration audit. FIX coherently: (1) Extract a SHARED merge-commit helper (e.g. commitShapeWithMerge(timeline, layerId, frameIndex, shapeObj)) factored from handleShapeCreated's planarMergeCommit logic (engine/planar merge.ts already provides planarMergeCommit + the passthrough/object-drawing rules) so every shape-creation path uses identical semantics; keep type:'drawing-object' = plain append (Object Drawing must NOT merge), and keep gradient/bitmap passthrough as today. (2) Route through it: agent stage_add_shape (packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts ~775), copy/paste (hooks/useClipboardHandlers.ts ~84/91 — only for pasted type:'shape'; non-shapes append as-is), and JSFL shape-creation commands (jsfl/runtime.ts ~2570/2601/2626/4214). (3) DRAW-ON-TWEEN (unverified concern): drawing on a frame inside a shape/motion tween folds into the governing keyframe (Shell.tsx ~1489 getGoverningKeyframe) — add an e2e/unit test: shape tween (frame0 -> frameN), draw a shape on a middle frame, play, assert the tween still animates correctly and geometry isn't corrupted; FIX only if the test shows corruption (e.g. don't merge into a tween keyframe in a corrupting way / handle correctly). VERIFY: build + core/authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); the 8 merge oracles still diff=0; add tests proving agent two-shape draw merges (union/cut), paste merges, JSFL draw merges (parity with UI draw), and the tween test. Don't regress Object-Drawing/gradient/symbol/undo paths (audit confirmed those correct). Update docs/36-vector-merge-model.md (all commit paths go through the shared merge helper). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry (if .tasks/.counter conflicts keep origin's). Scope: shared helper + registry.ts + useClipboardHandlers.ts + jsfl/runtime.ts + Shell.tsx (refactor to helper) + tests. If too big for one pass, ship the shared helper + agent + paste (the two HIGH) green and report JSFL/tween as a tracked follow-up.
